with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='chupa-serve-custody-') as temporary:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(temporary))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        llm, captured = FakeLLM([]), []
        factory_code = Driver.from_config.__func__.__code__
        def observe(frame, event, result):
            if frame.f_code is factory_code and event == 'return':
                captured.append(result)
        lock = Lockfile(rig.checkout.config.state_dir, instance_id='custody-probe', clock=rig.time)
        lock.acquire()
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        try:
            sys.setprofile(observe)
            result = await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm)
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)
            lock.release()
        [driver] = captured
        assert result == [] and llm.requests == [] and rig.exec.calls == []
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.journal.dir == rig.checkout.journal.dir
        print({'base_commit': base,
               'triage_driver_shares_checkout_journal': False,
               'triage_effects_share_checkout_journal': False,
               'same_journal_directory': True,
               'model_calls': len(llm.requests), 'process_calls': len(rig.exec.calls),
               'writer_substitution': False})
        driver.journal.close()
        rig.journal.close()
    assert await git.rev_parse(repo, 'HEAD') == head
    assert await git.status_porcelain(repo) == ''
    print({'final_head': head, 'final_status': ''})

asyncio.run(main())
